alex: Quick heads-up 1 — bringing up cust Zenith LoRA merge on int4 for a short smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/zenith-lora/pull/9  Can someone kick the invoices-mini + long-invoice eval? :wave:
nina: I can run it now, using runtime-intel64 int4. Will paste short summary.
eval-bot: Queued run for thread 1766000000 on runner-11. ETA ~5m.
nina: Running:
```bash
./eval_tool --model zenith-lora-merge --quant int4 --eval invoices-mini,long-invoice-samples --out /tmp/zenith_int4.json
```

nina: Quick results: token-likelihood +1.0% vs int8 baseline, amount extraction recall -9.8 pts, normalization edge-cases (parentheses, spaces) failing, dates mostly ok. Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/zenith/1766000000/results.json
vijay: +1.0% token-likely skew suggests tokenizer split mismatch between LoRA training tokenizer and runtime. What tokenizer version was used during LoRA training?
alex: PR notes: trained on tokenizer v3.2; runtime image uses v3.3 (merge changes for punctuation). Could explain numeric split differences.
sam: If it's tokenizer drift, we have two quick mitigations: (1) pin this customer route to int8 for rollout, (2) implement a token-alias remap on load + tiny int4 recalibration and run a targeted smoke. Which do we prefer short-term?
alex: Customer SLA is strict. Pin to int8 for immediate rollout. Vijay, can you prototype a remap shim and include a 100-sample quant recalibration? Nina will run the canary once PoC lands. I'll file ops ticket INC-3160.
vijay: On it. PoC sketch: build alias map model.tokens -> runtime.tokens, remap embedding rows and kv indices, then run scale recalibration for int4 kernels. Will post results.
eval-bot: Run completed; logs and artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/zenith/1766000000/ (240 samples).
nina: short loader log:
[2026-02-12T11:04:02Z] runner-11: loading zenith-lora-merge (quant=int4)
[2026-02-12T11:04:03Z] loader: tokenizer_hash(model)=0x9b2a vs runtime=0xad4f
[2026-02-12T11:04:04Z] WARN tokenizer: numeric-split mismatch for "$ (1,200.00 )"

alex: Great. We'll hold int4 for Zenith until remap+recalibration smoke passes. Closing for now, will update INC-3160 when ready. :thumbsup:
